## Summary
<!-- What does this PR do? One sentence. -->

## Type of Change
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `refactor` — code change with no behavior change
- [ ] `chore` — dependency / config / build
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only

## Testing
- [ ] Tested locally against a live WP install
- [ ] Added or updated unit tests where applicable

## Checklist
- [ ] Branch is `feature/*` or `fix/*` branched off `develop`
- [ ] No debug `error_log()` or `console.log()` left in
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` section updated
- [ ] Version bump in `syncly.php`, `readme.txt`, and `README.md` only if this is a release PR to `main`
